final_message:
I finished the gap analysis memo (dated April 9, 2025). It has 30 findings by severity: 6 Critical, 10 High, 9 Medium, 5 Low. The biggest problem is the start date: the clock ran from discovery on April 2, not the April 5 forensic confirmation, so the Netherlands (GDPR Art. 33, due April 5) and Brazil (LGPD, due April 7) regulator deadlines have already passed. The other critical findings: the GDPR Art. 34 encryption exception does not apply, five U.S. 30-day deadlines (Texas AG; Florida individuals and Attorney General's office; Colorado individuals and AG) fall on May 2, and New York may also be May 2 after a December 2024 amendment that still needs confirming. The memo also lists missing obligations, Pinnacle's business associate notice due by April 10, a corrected master timeline, a recommended plan of steps leading to a single May 2 mailing to all U.S. individuals, and corrections to the firm's own January 15 guidance memo.
